name: The companion swings the Anchor first
body: Dean's play-test (2026-11-16): the companion can't swing, and ideally she swings first so the player can watch and follow. A `companion_stop` can now be a swing stop: she walks to it, waits until the player is near enough to watch, swings the arc whose start post is beside it, and carries on from the far post. A cooperative arc works while she stands beside either of its posts, so having swung it first leaves it usable. Solo arcs are untouched.

comments.text: Filed before any code, from Dean's play-test feedback of 2026-11-16.

Built: `CompanionStop.swing`, `Companion.Swing` and the landing hold, `AnchorSystem.CanUse` counts either post, stops 7 and 8 and the checkpoints' stops in `streets` and `streets-later`. Decisions D-092 and D-093. Test: `engine/tests/host/the-anchor-swings-across-the-gap`. Not run in the cloud (no nox). Stays in-progress until the PR merges.

plan: 1. Companion gets the level's anchors and a swing leg. 2. Lead range, hurry, pause and nudge. 3. World files, docs, decisions, tests.
acceptance_criteria: She swings each streets arc ahead of the player
The cooperative arc still works with her at the far post
A solo player can still swing every solo arc without her
Respawning at a checkpoint sends her to the right side of a gap
